description:
Google Images Scraper

Google Images search results as JSON: original image URL, thumbnail, exact pixel dimensions, title, source page and domain for every image. No browser, no API key. From $1.50 per 1,000 images.

Pricing (pay per event, billed to your Apify account): Image scraped: $0.0015.

Runs on Apify as subimpact/google-images-scraper.

_maxChargeUsd.description: Per-run spending cap in USD (default 0.5). Passed to Apify as the run option maxTotalChargeUsd, so the run stops when it reaches this charge.
_maxChargeUsd.title: Max charge (USD)

_maxItems.description: How many dataset items to return to the model (1-1000, default 50). Truncates the response only; it does not change what the Actor collects or charges for.
_maxItems.title: Max items returned

colour.description: Google's dominant-colour filter for the image itself, not for the query text. Empty = any colour.
colour.title: Colour

concurrency.description: How many queries are fetched in parallel (1-8, default 3). Pages of the same query are always fetched one after another. Higher is faster but uses more proxy sessions at once.
concurrency.title: Concurrent queries

gl.description: Two-letter Google country setting, which decides the result set and the regional mix of sites: us, gb, my, sg, de, au, in. `uk` is accepted and mapped to gb.
gl.title: Country (gl)

hl.description: Google interface language: en, de, fr, ja, pt-BR, zh-CN, es-419. This is the language of the Google UI and of the titles Google returns.
hl.title: Language (hl)

imageSize.description: Google's own image-size filter. `large` returns the biggest originals (smallest short side measured: 674 px), `medium` the middle band, `icon` the small ones. Empty = any size.
imageSize.title: Image size

imageType.description: Google's own image-type filter: photo, clipart (logos, drawings, PNG/SVG), lineart (black-and-white drawings) or animated (mostly GIFs). Empty = any type.
imageType.title: Image type

maxImagesPerQuery.description: How many images to return per query (1-500, default 50). Google serves about 100 images per page, so 50 costs one page per query. Google rarely serves more than a few hundred images for a query; the actor stops as soon as a page comes back empty.
maxImagesPerQuery.title: Max images per query

maxItems.description: Global cost ceiling: the run stops after this many image rows across all queries (default 200, max 5000). At $0.0015 per image, 200 images cost $0.30 plus proxy usage. The default single query returns 50 images, so a default run costs about $0.08.
maxItems.title: Max images per run (all queries)

queries.description: One or more Google Images searches, e.g. `red panda` or `mid century modern sofa`. Each query returns up to `maxImagesPerQuery` images. Maximum 50 queries per run.
queries.title: Search queries

safeSearch.description: Send Google's SafeSearch filter (safe=active). On by default — the Store version of this Actor should not return adult images. Turn it off only if you have a reason to.
safeSearch.title: SafeSearch

timeRange.description: Only images from pages Google indexed recently: day, week, month or year. Useful for news and trends. Empty = any time.
timeRange.title: Time range

name: google_images
